name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
amount: Course fees + living-costs grant + one return flight per year
dlText: 26 Jan 2027, 12:00 noon UK time

eligibility.note: Students from low-income countries (per Oxford's list) who cannot study in their own country; overseas fee status

note: Apply to Oxford via UCAS first; the scholarship form goes in by late January and selection happens in April. Only around 2–3 awards a year, and you can apply only once.

name: Cambridge Trust Global Impact Scholarship
amount: International tuition + college fee + maintenance allowance + visa and IHS
dlText: No separate deadline – form sent by your college after an offer (UCAS deadline must be met)

eligibility.note: Overseas-fee-status undergraduates with high financial need who have overcome significant challenges to gain admission

note: Colleges send the Trust application form to international offer-holders; awards are made between mid-February and July. Most other Trust UG awards are part-cost (about £10k–15k/yr).

name: LSE Undergraduate Support Scheme
host: London School of Economics and Political Science
amount: Usually £15,000–£25,000 per year, renewable
dlText: ~23 Apr 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Overseas fee-status undergraduates who cannot meet their full costs of study

note: Need-based award for international LSE offer-holders; demand far exceeds funds. LSE says 2027-entry deadlines will be confirmed in early 2027 (2026 cycle closed ~23 Apr 2026).

name: UCL Global Undergraduate Scholarship
amount: 10 awards of full tuition + maintenance; 23 awards of full tuition only
dlText: ~27 Apr 2027, 17:00 BST (estimated from 2026 cycle)

eligibility.note: Overseas fee-paying students from low-income backgrounds who have applied to UCL

note: You must already have applied to UCL; late applications are refused even if your offer arrives after the deadline. 2026 cycle closed 27 Apr 2026 with results by early June.

name: Émile Boutmy Scholarship (Bachelor's)
amount: Full tuition exemption or €9,500/year tuition reduction
dlText: 13 Jan 2027 (foreign secondary schools; time not stated) · 1 Apr 2027 for French-system schools
tags: Tick it in your admission file
note: Select the scholarship in your Sciences Po online application before you submit; no later requests. Household must not file taxes in the EU.

name: Constructor University Full Tuition Talent Scholarship
amount: 100% of tuition for the standard study period (living costs not covered)
dlText: Global Talent Examination: 29 Oct 2026, 14:00 UTC (closed)
note: Full tuition is reached through an extended merit scholarship plus an optional deferral of up to €10,000. Every applicant is also considered automatically for the smaller Academic Achievement Scholarship.

name: Bocconi 100% Full Tuition Waiver (Bocconi4Access)
amount: 100% of ordinary tuition and fees (80/60/40/20% waivers also exist)
dlText: Deadline set in the Bocconi4Access 2027-28 call – check official page

eligibility.note: International first-year Bachelor's and Law students; based on family economic situation

note: One application under Bocconi4Access covers the full and partial waivers. Renewal needs enrolment and credit requirements to be met.

name: NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship
amount: Subsidised tuition (after Tuition Grant) + S$5,800/yr living + S$5,000/yr housing + S$1,750 computer
dlText: No separate deadline – considered via your NUS admission application
note: You must take up the MOE Tuition Grant, which carries a 3-year bond to work in Singapore. Allowance figures vary between NUS pages; check the current handbook.

name: Nanyang Scholarship
amount: Subsidised tuition (after Tuition Grant) + S$6,500/yr living + up to S$2,000/yr housing + computer allowance
dlText: Same closing date as NTU admission for your qualification – check official page
note: The scholarship application window is the admission window; late applications are not considered. No bond beyond the 3-year Tuition Grant bond for internationals.

name: Lee Kong Chian Scholars' Programme
amount: Subsidised tuition waived (after MOE Tuition Grant) + S$5,000/yr living + S$1,800 computer + S$16,000 Global Opportunities grant
dlText: No separate deadline – considered with your SMU admission application

eligibility.note: Listed on SMU's scholarships-for-international-students page; non-Singaporeans must take the MOE Tuition Grant – confirm current international eligibility with SMU

note: SMU's flagship undergraduate scholarship, renewable for up to four years. International recipients sign the MOE Tuition Grant agreement and must work for a Singapore-based company for 3 years after graduating.

name: CUHK Admission Scholarships (non-local undergraduates)
host: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
amount: HK$5,000 up to full tuition (non-local tuition HK$230,000/yr in 2027-28)
dlText: No separate application – automatic with your CUHK admission application
note: All admitted full-time undergraduates are considered automatically; only the top awards reach full tuition, and faculties and colleges add their own awards. CUHK offers no need-based financial aid to international students.

name: HKUST Future Leaders Award
host: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
amount: Top tier: full tuition + living allowance, renewable (base tier one-off HK$50,000)
dlText: ~30 Nov 2026 (estimated from 2025 cycle; time not stated)
note: For non-local applicants who have overcome challenges and are recommended for admission in the Early Round; the full-tuition-plus-living tier needs proof of exceptional financial need. Post-secondary applicants are excluded.

name: APU Tuition Reduction Scholarship for International Students
amount: 30%, 50%, 65% or 100% tuition reduction (100% ≈ ¥1,455,000/yr for 2027 entry)
dlText: Several admission rounds with deadlines by country of residence – check the Application Schedule

eligibility.note: International applicants who hold or will obtain 'Student' residence status in Japan

note: Awarded at admission on academic ability and financial need, covering up to 8 semesters if you pass a performance review each semester. Deadlines are never extended.

name: UIC Full-Tuition Admission Scholarship (international students)
amount: Full tuition for 4 years (living costs not covered)
dlText: No separate application – automatic with UIC admission
note: Recipients are picked from admitted international applicants on academic credentials; offers come with the admission packet. You must keep a set GPA each semester.

name: KFUPM Full Scholarship for International Students
host: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
amount: Tuition waiver + free campus housing + monthly stipend + textbooks + medical care
dlText: Primary Admission Track registration 10–24 Jan 2027 (time not stated); SAT track 1–11 Feb 2027
note: KFUPM's international page says students living outside Saudi Arabia get a full scholarship; an older Student Affairs page mentions tuition for non-Saudis, so confirm. Admission runs through set tracks (Primary, SAT, Olympiad).

name: Khalifa University Scholarship for International Undergraduates
host: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
amount: Up to 100% of tuition depending on CGPA (e.g. 100% at CGPA ≥3.3 in engineering/science); no stipend
dlText: Automatic with your KU application – check official page for admission deadlines
note: Applying to KU enrolls you for scholarship consideration; the percentage depends on academic performance and seats. KU's FAQ says no stipend is offered to undergraduates.

name: Korea University Admission Scholarships for International Freshmen
amount: Full tuition for 8 semesters (Anam Global) or 4 semesters (KU STEM, KU Global Friends); smaller tiers too
dlText: Awarded with admission each spring/fall intake – check the current application guide
note: Anam Global goes to the top-ranked admitted student per track; KU Global Friends gives full tuition for 4 semesters to strong applicants from Africa, South America and other developing countries.

name: UNIST International Undergraduate Scholarship
host: UNIST (Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology)
amount: Full tuition in first term (then full/half by GPA) + living scholarship up to ₩630,000/month incl. meals
dlText: Awarded on admission – check UNIST international admission dates
note: Living scholarship tiers (Gold ₩630k, Silver ₩330k, Dream ₩130k per month) are set by UNIST from admission results. Later tuition waivers depend on credits and GPA.

name: SNU Glo-Harmony Scholarship
amount: Full tuition + ₩600,000/month for up to 8 semesters
dlText: Applied for after admission – check SNU scholarship notices

eligibility.note: Admitted international undergraduates from countries on the OECD DAC recipient list

note: Post-admission award for students from developing countries. SNU also offers Global Scholarships (tuition + ₩1.2M/month for up to 4 semesters) to some freshmen.

name: Duke Kunshan University Full Scholarship
amount: Full cost of attendance (up to 3 awards; need-based aid up to full tuition for others)
dlText: 15 Nov 2026 (Early Decision) / 1 Feb 2027 (Regular Decision); time zone not stated
note: Up to 3 full scholarships for international first-years with financial hardship and top academics; a separate application and essay are required. Aid can't be requested after admission, and DKU notes that applicants with hardship who are not selected are not admitted.

name: Monash International Leadership Scholarship
amount: 100% of course fees for the minimum degree length (no living costs/OSHC)
dlText: No application – automatic with an unconditional Monash undergraduate offer
note: Selected on academic achievement from international students with a full offer for full-time study at an Australian campus. Current Monash students and Monash College/Foundation Year pathways are excluded.

name: UNSW International Scientia Coursework Scholarship
amount: Full tuition for the program's minimum duration, or A$20,000/yr
dlText: Term 1 2027 round closed 30 Oct 2026 (time not stated)
nextText: Later 2027 terms have their own rounds – check UNSW Scholarships
fields: Any UNSW coursework degree (not UNSW Online/Canberra)
note: Judged on academic merit, leadership and extracurricular involvement. Applications run per intake term through the UNSW international scholarships form.

name: Sydney International Undergraduate Academic Excellence Scholarship
amount: 100% tuition + SSAF for the standard length of a single undergraduate degree (up to 4 years)
dlText: Semester 1 2027 closed; Semester 2 2027 applications open – closing date not stated
note: Only students with top marks in their home-country school curriculum can apply. Awarded in semesters one and two each year.

name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship (50% tier)
amount: 50% tuition reduction for the degree (25% for other students)
dlText: No application – automatic with your ANU admission

eligibility.note: 50% tier listed for students from India, Indonesia, Vietnam, South-East Asia, Europe and the Americas; others get 25%

note: Eligible applicants are considered for 50% first, then 25%. ANU's FAQ refers to 2023–2025 intakes, so confirm the tiers for 2027.

name: ER.GO Right-to-Study Scholarship (Borsa di studio DSU)
host: ER.GO – Emilia-Romagna regional agency for the right to study
amount: Need-based grant + tuition exemption – check official page (bando)
dlText: 24 Aug 2026, 16:00 CEST (2026/27 call, closed)
note: Non-EU students with family abroad use an equivalent ISEE based on their home country; there is a list of countries for the figurative ISEE. Merit (credit) requirements apply from the second year.

name: DiSCo Lazio Right-to-Study Scholarship (Borsa di studio)
host: DiSCo – Lazio regional agency for the right to study
amount: Need-based grant (top 'off-site' bracket if family lives abroad) – check official page
dlText: 22 Jul 2026 (2026/27 call, closed; time not stated)
note: Students with family abroad sign the ISEEUP at a DiSCo-approved CAF (by 10 Dec 2026 for this round) and are automatically classed as off-site. First-year non-EU students are ranked by income.

name: SJTU International New Students Scholarship (First-Class)
amount: Full tuition + CNY 2,500/month living + CNY 1,000/month housing subsidy + insurance, 4 years (2nd class: 50% tuition)
dlText: Regular Decision 31 Mar 2027 (Beijing time); Early Action closed 1 Nov 2026
note: Awarded by committee with the admission offer based on academic and interview ranking. Applicants need CSCA (with math) scores by 30 Jun 2027.

name: Ashesi University Need-Based Scholarships
amount: Partial (30% to nearly 100%) or comprehensive: tuition, housing, stipend, insurance, travel, laptop
dlText: Apply for aid with your admission application – no scholarship requests after admission

eligibility.note: Admitted Ashesi undergraduates with demonstrated financial need; Mastercard Foundation-funded awards target young Africans

note: Ashesi gives no merit scholarships; you submit a financial-aid form, need letter and bank/pay records. About 43% of students are on full or partial scholarship.

name: ALU Mandela Scholarships
amount: Mainly tuition (US$3,000–4,000/yr); living costs not covered
dlText: Select it in the Financial Aid section of your ALU application – per intake

eligibility.note: Top academic performers from across Africa

note: Merit award with no separate application; students fund accommodation, meals and other costs themselves. Need-based full rides at ALU come via the Mastercard Foundation programme.
